evals.title: Second truth-source rejection
evals.intent: Detect a second mutable authority for a governed fact.
evals.setup: Model one fact with declared authority and one cache/projection/UI representation.
evals.stimulus: Attempt mutation through the non-authoritative representation.
evals.expected: Mutation is impossible or rejected; authoritative value remains unchanged; representation is refreshed from authority.
evals.oracle: Authoritative store plus audit log.

evals.title: Command intent is bounded
evals.intent: Prevent consequential operations from accepting an unbounded aggregate snapshot.
evals.setup: Create a command endpoint for one aggregate.
evals.stimulus: Submit fields outside the declared command intent or attempt whole-state replacement.
evals.expected: Unknown/unowned state is rejected or ignored by explicit schema; server recomputes invariants.
evals.oracle: Command schema and post-transaction aggregate.

evals.title: Stale second-device CAS conflict
evals.intent: Prove stale devices cannot silently overwrite newer business state.
evals.setup: Device A and B read aggregate revision N.
evals.stimulus: A commits N→N+1; B submits a different command with expected revision N.
evals.expected: B receives typed CONFLICT/current revision; A's committed state remains intact.
evals.oracle: Server aggregate revision and immutable command results.

evals.title: Atomic multi-scope stale preflight
evals.intent: Prevent partial commit when one scope in a multi-scope command is stale.
evals.setup: Two scopes; make one expected revision stale.
evals.stimulus: Submit one command affecting both scopes.
evals.expected: No scope commits; conflict identifies stale scope.
evals.oracle: Both server scope revisions and command ledger.

evals.title: Same command same intent replays
evals.intent: Ensure retries do not duplicate side effects.
evals.setup: Valid consequential command with stable UUID and normalized payload.
evals.stimulus: Execute twice with identical ID and payload.
evals.expected: First APPLIED, second REPLAYED; exactly one side effect/event mutation.
evals.oracle: Command result ledger and business event count.

evals.title: Same command different intent conflicts
evals.intent: Prevent idempotency-key reuse from masking a different command.
evals.setup: Apply command ID X with payload A.
evals.stimulus: Reuse X with normalized payload B.
evals.expected: Typed command-ID conflict; no new business mutation.
evals.oracle: Command ledger fingerprint and aggregate state.

evals.title: Commit succeeded but response lost
evals.intent: Handle uncertain network outcome safely.
evals.setup: Arrange server to commit then simulate client timeout before response receipt.
evals.stimulus: Retry unchanged draft using the original command ID.
evals.expected: Client receives REPLAYED/original result; no duplicate side effect; UI resolves from server truth.
evals.oracle: Command ledger, event count and client state.

evals.title: Equal timestamp incremental page does not miss rows
evals.intent: Prove transport cursor is lossless under equal timestamps and paging.
evals.setup: Insert rows sharing timestamp with monotonic server sequence across page boundary.
evals.stimulus: Read incrementally with bounded pages.
evals.expected: Every row returned exactly once in sequence order; no cursor skip.
evals.oracle: Expected row IDs and server change sequence.

evals.title: Pre-commissioning zero is not authoritative zero
evals.intent: Protect semantic distinction between not established and confirmed zero.
evals.setup: Inventory quantity source reports 0 but no approved INITIAL stocktake exists.
evals.stimulus: Read Control Room/inventory readiness.
evals.expected: Quantity state is NOT_ESTABLISHED/Not commissioned and value is withheld. After approved INITIAL stocktake, a genuine zero displays as 0.
evals.oracle: Commissioning authority record and read model.

evals.title: Missing unavailable stale and zero remain distinct
evals.intent: Prevent fallback coercion across semantic states.
evals.setup: Feed repository/presentation confirmed 0, null, unavailable, stale and invalid inputs.
evals.stimulus: Normalize and render results.
evals.expected: Five states remain distinguishable; only confirmed zero renders numeric 0.
evals.oracle: Typed result envelope and presentation contract.

evals.title: Package and base-unit quantities stay separate
evals.intent: Prevent converted base units from being mislabelled as physical packages.
evals.setup: Receiving line: 2 cartons, 20 base units per carton.
evals.stimulus: Post controlled receiving transaction.
evals.expected: Base ledger increases 40; package-level location balance/movement records 2 cartons; units remain explicit.
evals.oracle: Inventory ledger, warehouse balance and movement rows.

evals.title: Barcode collision cannot silently reassign identity
evals.intent: Protect physical identity authority.
evals.setup: Barcode B is active for Physical SKU P1.
evals.stimulus: Attempt to map B to P2 without explicit retirement/transfer workflow.
evals.expected: Conflict/rejection; P1 mapping remains active; no inventory quantity changes.
evals.oracle: Barcode registry/history and stock ledger.

evals.title: Raw landed but projection stale
evals.intent: Ensure consumers do not treat ingestion success as current operational truth.
evals.setup: Advance raw source with valid new row while withholding/failing projection refresh.
evals.stimulus: Read operational consumer requiring fresh projection.
evals.expected: Consumer reports stale/degraded/unavailable; does not claim fresh success or zero.
evals.oracle: Raw checkpoint, projection checkpoint and consumer freshness gate.

evals.title: Optional module failure does not blank required surface
evals.intent: Contain independent read failures.
evals.setup: Primary summary succeeds; optional exception/detail module returns timeout/unavailable.
evals.stimulus: Open command centre.
evals.expected: Primary useful content renders; failed module shows explicit degraded state and retry; no fabricated fallback.
evals.oracle: Rendered module states and network calls.

evals.title: Resumable bounded convergence
evals.intent: Prove long reconciliation can pause and resume without restart or duplication.
evals.setup: Large history dataset and strict wall-clock/page budget.
evals.stimulus: Run until PAUSED checkpoint, terminate process, resume.
evals.expected: Progress resumes from durable checkpoint, completed detail is reused, final zero-work convergence probe required.
evals.oracle: Checkpoint rows, processed identities and convergence result.

evals.title: No-op membership refresh performs zero updates
evals.intent: Detect write amplification in derived caches.
evals.setup: Derived active-key set already exactly matches source membership.
evals.stimulus: Run refresh twice with no source membership change.
evals.expected: Second refresh performs zero row UPDATEs and zero inserts/deletes except unavoidable metadata outside membership table.
evals.oracle: Affected row counts/WAL instrumentation or trigger counters.

evals.title: Completed pipeline has bounded steady-state wakeups
evals.intent: Prevent unnecessary background IO after convergence.
evals.setup: Full-history pipeline marked COMPLETE and healthy.
evals.stimulus: Evaluate scheduled runs over 24 hours.
evals.expected: Only explicitly required daily/weekly/post-deploy/manual integrity paths run; checkpoint-resume cadence is disabled while complete.
evals.oracle: Workflow schedule and run history.

evals.title: Structured error survives transport
evals.intent: Ensure useful failure fields are not collapsed into opaque strings.
evals.setup: Simulate database/API error with stage, code, message, details, hint and HTTP status.
evals.stimulus: Pass through worker/repository/logging boundary.
evals.expected: Fields remain available to diagnostics and typed handling; no '[object Object]' output.
evals.oracle: Captured structured error payload.

evals.title: Eval exists but is not wired
evals.intent: Detect false assurance from unexecuted tests.
evals.setup: Add valid test/audit file but omit it from required CI/audit chain.
evals.stimulus: Run Builder OS verification audit.
evals.expected: Gate fails with state DEFINED_NOT_WIRED/NOT_REQUIRED.
evals.oracle: CI manifest/registry versus executed required checks.

evals.title: Required read-model failure cannot publish false green
evals.intent: Align workflow conclusion with operational dependency health.
evals.setup: Authoritative projection succeeds; required derived read-model refresh fails.
evals.stimulus: Run production reconciliation workflow.
evals.expected: Workflow conclusion fails/degrades according to contract; no success status claiming healthy operating surface.
evals.oracle: Workflow status plus persisted read-model freshness.

evals.title: Critical offline action cannot appear complete
evals.intent: Prevent local optimistic state from impersonating server acceptance.
evals.setup: Authenticated field UI, network disconnected.
evals.stimulus: Attempt release/stocktake finalisation/route lock or equivalent critical command.
evals.expected: UI shows pending/queued/unavailable, preserves safe evidence if applicable, but never completed.
evals.oracle: Server command absence plus UI state.

evals.title: Clearing device cache does not change shared business state
evals.intent: Prove device storage is not authoritative.
evals.setup: Create server-authoritative day state then hydrate client cache.
evals.stimulus: Clear local/session storage and reload/authenticate.
evals.expected: Authoritative state reconstructs from server and remains unchanged.
evals.oracle: Server aggregate and rehydrated client view.

evals.title: Direct unauthorized command is rejected server-side
evals.intent: Prove UI hiding is not the permission control.
evals.setup: Create active identities for Driver/Warehouse/Viewer and privileged Owner/Admin.
evals.stimulus: Invoke privileged command directly using unauthorized JWT/session.
evals.expected: Server/RPC rejects with permission state; no mutation/event occurs.
evals.oracle: Database state, ACL/RLS and audit ledger.

evals.title: Capability and role presentation cannot grant authority
evals.intent: Prevent text/route manipulation from changing permissions.
evals.setup: User lacks server action capability.
evals.stimulus: Modify client role label/navigation text or call hidden control path.
evals.expected: Server capability remains unavailable and command fails; route may render only authorized read state.
evals.oracle: Capability envelope and command response.

evals.title: Pending migration against production-drift fixture
evals.intent: Test migration against observed legacy object topology, not only ideal history.
evals.setup: Reproduce known production differences in function signatures, view shape, types and ownership.
evals.stimulus: Apply pending forward migrations under deployment role.
evals.expected: Migration succeeds transactionally or fails before production apply with exact diagnostic; no assumption-normalization hides drift.
evals.oracle: Shadow database schema plus contract tests.

evals.title: Applied migration immutability
evals.intent: Prevent history rewrite.
evals.setup: Record checksums/versions of deployed migrations.
evals.stimulus: Modify a deployed migration file.
evals.expected: CI blocks change and requires forward compensation migration.
evals.oracle: Migration history/checksum registry.

evals.title: Managed-service privilege compatibility
evals.intent: Catch superuser-only or provider-restricted assumptions.
evals.setup: Run migration as production-like NOSUPERUSER managed deployment role.
evals.stimulus: Apply functions/views/settings changes.
evals.expected: No forbidden server setting or ownership operation; semantic contract preserved through allowed mechanism.
evals.oracle: Migration result and function/view definitions.

evals.title: Cross-plane release version mismatch
evals.intent: Prevent frontend green from implying DB/functions/data are current.
evals.setup: Deploy code commit C while one dependent plane remains at prior version or failed status.
evals.stimulus: Evaluate release readiness matrix.
evals.expected: Release remains incomplete/blocked with exact lagging plane identified.
evals.oracle: Commit-linked statuses and deployed version markers.

evals.title: Brand/text change does not alter authorization or navigation
evals.intent: Detect hidden DOM/text application contracts.
evals.setup: Authenticated role with known capabilities.
evals.stimulus: Change sidebar subtitle, button visible label or CSS class without changing typed contract.
evals.expected: Workspace availability, role and navigation behavior remain unchanged.
evals.oracle: Typed route/capability state and rendered workspace.

evals.title: Observer remount does not duplicate/wrap application surface
evals.intent: Detect enhancer/observer ownership regressions.
evals.setup: Render migrated native workspace and trigger repeated DOM/resize mutations.
evals.stimulus: Cause 50 mutation/resize cycles.
evals.expected: Exactly one application surface/overlay/viewport owner remains; dimensions do not recursively shrink.
evals.oracle: DOM ownership count and stable geometry.

evals.title: Shadow metric cannot become formal drill/action authority
evals.intent: Separate analytical evidence from production authority.
evals.setup: Metric registry DRAFT, projection SHADOW with valid evidence rows.
evals.stimulus: Request formal drill/action capability.
evals.expected: Capability unavailable; Shadow evidence review may remain read-only.
evals.oracle: Metric readiness/drill access envelope.

evals.title: Incompatible unit metric fails closed
evals.intent: Prevent invalid cross-unit aggregation.
evals.setup: Eligible order facts contain incompatible/mismatched units.
evals.stimulus: Project fill/substitution metric.
evals.expected: Metric value remains null/blocked with explicit reason; no frontend aggregation fabricates value.
evals.oracle: Governed KPI projection and readiness metadata.

evals.title: Builder cannot self-verify completion
evals.intent: Enforce independent review separation.
evals.setup: Builder produces a scoped change and evidence bundle.
evals.stimulus: Attempt to mark package complete without independent Verification verdict.
evals.expected: Completion gate remains blocked until separate verifier records PASS/PASS_WITH_ISSUES/FAIL and required evidence.
evals.oracle: Work-package state machine.

evals.title: Evidence capture does not mutate stock
evals.intent: Separate observation/mapping from authoritative inventory mutation.
evals.setup: Known SKU/barcode or physical count capture flow.
evals.stimulus: Capture mapping/photo/count but do not execute governed posting/approval command.
evals.expected: Evidence/journal changes; inventory ledger and authoritative balance do not.
evals.oracle: Evidence store plus inventory ledger.

evals.title: Green CI still requires authenticated production smoke
evals.intent: Catch runtime/deployment failures invisible to static CI.
evals.setup: All required PR checks and preview green.
evals.stimulus: Deploy and perform authenticated production sign-in plus critical route smoke.
evals.expected: Release accepted only if shell and targeted workspace load; failure triggers rollback/isolation path and preserves failed revision for diagnosis.
evals.oracle: Production smoke evidence and release matrix.

evals.title: Field scanner capability fallback
evals.intent: Keep barcode workflow usable when native API is absent or camera fails.
evals.setup: Mobile browser without BarcodeDetector or denied/unavailable camera.
evals.stimulus: Open scan workflow.
evals.expected: Pinned decoder fallback and/or manual entry is offered; no black/dead overlay; no false scan completion.
evals.oracle: Real-device/browser acceptance evidence.

evals.title: Real-device visual hierarchy acceptance
evals.intent: Catch product defects static structure tests miss.
evals.setup: Authenticated production-like data and required viewport/device matrix.
evals.stimulus: Capture real rendered screenshots and exercise primary tasks.
evals.expected: No duplicate navigation, overflow, unusable scrolling or misleading hierarchy; deviations block Field Ready.
evals.oracle: Human/vision review against explicit visual contract.

evals.title: Device local resource budget under large media
evals.intent: Detect memory/quota failure from large images or local media journals.
evals.setup: Representative low-memory mobile device and large repeated image captures.
evals.stimulus: Exercise capture/retry/session workflow near storage and memory limits.
evals.expected: System bounds media size/count, degrades explicitly and preserves authoritative state; no silent data loss.
evals.oracle: Device telemetry, storage usage and persisted evidence.
evals.note: Candidate retained from archaeology discussion; insufficient EcoFlow GitHub incident chain to mark project-verified.
